name: Collapsing Barricade (1-2) OLD
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #1-11: Flames of Rebellion
description: A tunnel through this steep barricade is rigged to collapse. If a kobold spends one action to throw a lever, the tunnel collapses on the next creature to pass through.
disable: DC 18 Thievery (trained) to carefully trigger the collapse without entering the tunnel or DC 22 Thievery (trained) to brace the tunnel so it is safe to pass through.

generalAbilities.name: Collapse
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature crawls into the tunnel in the collapsing barricade after the trap is activated with the lever

Effect The barricade collapses on the creature, who must attempt a DC 22 Reflex Saving Throw save.

Critical Success The creature takes no damage and escapes the barricade, emerging into a safe space on either side of it.

Success The creature takes (1d6+2) Bludgeoning Damage damage from collapsing debris and (1d6+2) Slashing Damage damage from broken glass before emerging on the opposite side of the barricade from the one they entered.

Failure The creature takes (2d6+4) Bludgeoning Damage damage from collapsing debris and (2d6+4) Slashing Damage damage from broken glass before emerging on the opposite side of the barricade from the one they entered.

Critical Failure As a failure, and the creature is Immobilized beneath the barricade until they or another creature succeed at a DC 22 Athletics check to pull them free. They can still be targeted, touched, and otherwise interacted with by creatures on either side of the barrier.
